name: list_drafts
description:
List the user's Outlook email drafts. Returns draft IDs, subjects, recipients, and preview snippets.

Use this tool to:
- Check what drafts the user has pending
- Find a specific draft to update or send
- Get message IDs for use with outlook_update_draft or outlook_send_draft

Results include message_id (needed for updating/sending), subject, recipients, and a body preview.
Drafts are sorted by most recently modified first.

max_results.description: Maximum number of drafts to return (default 10, max 50)
